existing_code.summary: Basic router with parse_request, route_request, process_single_request. Has 3 stub handlers (quality, coverage, gaps). Not used by main CLI.

test_patterns.style: Pure function tests with mock I/O
patterns: Test happy path and error cases

integration_patterns.pattern: Each command is a glint.Command(Nil) function that processes input.args and calls halt(exit_code)

key_functions: success(action, command, data, spec_path, next_actions) -> JsonResponse
failure(action, command, data, errors, spec_path, next_actions, exit_code) -> JsonResponse
output(response) -> Nil - prints JSON to stdout
to_json(response) -> Json - converts to JSON for tests

gaps_identified: Handlers are stubs - need to call actual analyzer functions
No stdin loop for continuous JSONL processing

success_criteria: Integration with main CLI (jsonl mode or stdin mode)
Validation of args structure for each command
JSONL streaming from stdin with line-by-line processing
